contradictions.description: Project Tripletail was reported in January 2024 as a 400 MW Eagle Mountain plan, while Tract's current company pages show Pole Canyon at 1,700 MW and Pony Express at 120 MW. Local CRA records describe north parcels near Pole Canyon and a south parcel east of Pony Express, so the projects appear related, but the public sources reviewed do not explicitly map Tripletail to the current named sites or explain the capacity increase.

Eagle Mountain/EDCUtah and city agreement materials describe roughly 668/672 acres for the original Tract/Tripletail acquisition or development agreement, while current Tract pages list 844 acres at Pole Canyon plus 225 acres at Pony Express. The difference may reflect additional properties or a changed marketing scope, but no official crosswalk was located.
